## Nano Banana Pro API

Nano Banana Pro is an image generation and image editing model by Google, available on the Venice API as `nano-banana-pro`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Nano Banana Pro is the Pro tier of Google's Gemini-based Nano Banana image models, generating at up to 4K from prompts of up to 32,768 characters. It pairs with Nano Banana Pro Edit for high-quality edits.

### Nano Banana Pro API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `nano-banana-pro` | Generate | Anonymized | $0.18 / image |
| `nano-banana-pro-edit` | Edit | Anonymized | $0.18 / edit |

### Nano Banana Pro specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | Google |
| Released | Nov 20, 2025 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |
| Resolutions | 1K, 2K, 4K |
| Aspect ratios | 1:1, 5:4, 4:3, 3:2, 16:9, 21:9, 4:1, 8:1, 4:5, 3:4, 2:3, 9:16, 1:4, 1:8 |
| Prompt limit | 32,768 characters |

### How to use the Nano Banana Pro API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate` with `"model": "nano-banana-pro"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/image/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "nano-banana-pro",
    "prompt": "A retro travel poster with the bold headline \"VENICE\" in large condensed serif type, sunset color palette",
    "resolution": "1K",
    "aspect_ratio": "1:1"
  }'
```
